observations: Photo 0 shows a used car engine with a black intake manifold and various components attached.
The engine appears to be in a workshop or storage area with other engines and parts around it.
There is a watermark 'BLESSED CHIEF' across the center of the image.
No visible branding or model tags are readable on the engine block or components in the photo.
The engine has a silver or gray metallic finish with some rust and grime visible.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model tags in photo 0 to confirm Toyota or 2005. The '1zz' designation is not readable on the engine block or components.

risks.risk: Engine is not from a 2005 Toyota Corolla or is not a 1ZZ-FE engine
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block with visible casting numbers or a label showing '1ZZ-FE' or 'Corolla 2005'
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used engine without model-specific value

risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running or a close-up of the cylinder head, crankshaft, and internal components

risks.risk: Gearbox is not included or is damaged
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox attached to the engine or a separate photo of the gearbox alone
risks.if_unproven: priced as gearbox not included or damaged

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the engine block showing casting numbers or model identifiers
Photo of the gearbox if included, or confirmation it is not included
Video or photo of the engine running or a close-up of internal components
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
